title: Navigate to the alert rule page

blocks.content:
Navigate to the alert rule creation page and give your rule a name.

To navigate to the alert rule page, complete the following steps:

1. In the Grafana side menu, click **Alerting**.
2. Click **Alert rules**.
3. Click **+ New alert rule**.
4. In the **Rule name** field, enter a descriptive name for your alert rule, for example `High CPU usage`.

You should see the alert rule creation page with the Default mode selected.
In the next milestone, you learn how to build a query that selects your data.
